extension.name: AI Quota Bar
extension.description: Show Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity quota in the status bar.
configuration.title: AI Quota Bar
configuration.agyPath: Absolute path to agy (leave empty to auto-detect); Windows supports only .exe files.
configuration.warningThreshold: Warning threshold for the remaining percentage.
configuration.criticalThreshold: Critical threshold for the remaining percentage.
configuration.notificationEnabled: Notify when quota decreases to a worse level or recovers.
configuration.providers.claude.enabled: Show Claude Code quota in the status bar. Turn off if you no longer use it; when disabled, the extension does not read Claude Code credentials or call its API.
configuration.providers.codex.enabled: Show Codex quota in the status bar. Turn off if you no longer use it; when disabled, the extension does not read Codex credentials or call its API.
configuration.providers.agy.enabled: Show Antigravity quota in the status bar. Turn off if you no longer use it; when disabled, the extension does not run agy.
